# 2 Baruch Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Fall of Jerusalem

---

**8:1** And-the-Chaldeans-entered and-took-possession-of-the-house and-burned-the-temple and-devastated-all-that-was-in-it.

**8:2** And-they-led-away the-people into-captivity and-slew some-of-them and-made-others-of-them-into-servants.

**8:3** And-Baruch sat-down upon-the-ruins and-wept and-mourned over-Zion, and-I-lifted-up my-lamentations over-the-beloved-city.

**8:4** And-the-LORD said-to-me: "Go, tell-Jeremiah and-all-those-like-him, what-has-been-ordained by-me for-this-people."

**8:5** For I-will-gather-together my-people and-I-will-act-toward-them according-to-my-mercy."

---

*EMET notes: The Chaldean entry completes the destruction begun by the angels. The brief divine word (vv.4-5) redirects Baruch from passive mourning to prophetic mission.*
